facts.text: By March 2025, 43 of 181 projects in Harris County's 2018 flood bond program were complete.
$864M of the $2.5B bond had been spent by that point.
Out of $834 million in partner (FRT) funds originally anticipated, only $165 million materialized.
Funds were allocated 'as-needed,' not 'in order of prioritization scores'; second-quartile projects received $317.5M vs. $187.3M for the first quartile.
Flood bond project information is published by Harris County Precinct 4.
Addicks and Barker reservoirs date from the 1940s and were rated 'extremely high risk'; the Corps found a 'high risk of failure due to seepage and piping' and more than $100M in repairs were needed.
5,138 of about 14,000 homes inside the reservoirs flooded in Harvey; about 4,000 were built after Allison.
Reservoir releases during Harvey flooded thousands more homes downstream.
Neither the city nor the county requires flood disclosure to buyers; the only warning is a plat note.
